Unraid NAS Power Consumption and Cost

Created with Thinking March 7, 2026 at 08:25 PM
You said

A NAS running on Unraid, with hardware specifications of a Intel i7-6700K CPU, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB GPU, and 8 GB DDR4 RAM, and being used as a at-home NAS would consume how much electricity per day, month, and year, and how much would that usage correspond to electricity cost approximately in Barrie, Ontario?


Assuming usage is low or moderate: Maybe 10 Docker containers running Tailscale, Self-Hosted Music (Navidrome), Plex/Jellyfin Server, Immich being fed family photos occasionally, Rclone interfacing with Cloud Storage, Document Management, Office Suite, etc.

Running an Unraid NAS with an i7-6700K and a GTX 1060 is a classic "overpowered but versatile" home lab setup. While those components were top-tier gaming gear in their day, in a NAS environment, they spend most of their time "sipping" power rather than gulping it.

In Barrie, Ontario, your costs are influenced by Alectra Utilities' 2026 winter rates and the Ontario Electricity Rebate (OER).

Estimated Power Consumption

For a system with 10 active Docker containers (Tailscale, Navidrome, Plex, etc.) and roughly 4–6 hard drives, your average draw will likely sit between 60W and 90W.

  • Idle/Base Load (~50W-60W): This includes the CPU at low utilization, the GPU in its idle state (~7W–12W), RAM, and Unraid's specialty: spinning down inactive hard drives.

  • Moderate Load (~80W-100W): This accounts for Plex/Jellyfin hardware transcoding using the 1060, Immich indexing new photos, or Rclone moving data.

Estimated Electricity Cost in Barrie, ON

As of March 2026, Ontario residential rates (Tier 1) are approximately 12.0¢/kWh. However, once you add delivery charges, regulatory fees, and the 13% HST—then subtract the 23.5% Ontario Electricity Rebate—your "all-in" effective rate is approximately $0.14 per kWh.

Note: This estimate assumes you are on Tiered Pricing. If you are on Time-of-Use (TOU), your costs may be slightly lower if the NAS performs heavy tasks (like backups or library scans) overnight.

Factors Influencing Your Bill

  • GPU Power States: In Unraid, ensure you have the Nvidia-Driver plugin installed. Without it, the GTX 1060 might stay in a high-power "P0" state instead of dropping to "P8" idle, which can add 15W–20W to your baseline.

  • Unraid Drive Spin-Down: One of Unraid’s biggest advantages is that it only spins up the specific drive being accessed. A spinning HDD uses ~6W, while a spun-down one uses <0.5W. If your family photos (Immich) and music (Navidrome) are on the same disk, the others can stay asleep.

  • CPU C-States: Ensure "C-States" are enabled in your BIOS. The i7-6700K is quite efficient at idling if the motherboard allows it to enter deep sleep states.
